# Process - Iteration 1

## Ranked issue list (clusters by # failing tasks × trials, biggest first)
| rank | cluster | tasks | shared root cause | tag (KNOWLEDGE / BEHAVIORAL / CAPABILITY-GAP) | planned change class |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| 1 | FORMULA_INSTEAD_OF_VALUE | 37378, 46897, 53383, 55049, 6698, 7902, 8942 | Agent writes Excel formulas instead of literal values. | KNOWLEDGE | Tighten Output Contract |
| 2 | MISSING_VALUES | 227-40, 48527, 50768, 59196, 80-42, 9569 | Agent fails to write values to all target cells. | BEHAVIORAL | Ordered Procedure / Verification |
| 3 | EXCEL_ERROR_STRING | 37456, 53647, 54144, 56563 | Agent writes Excel error strings (#N/A, etc.). | KNOWLEDGE | Add Error Handling Rule |
| 4 | WRONG_VALUE_RIGHT_TYPE | 267-18, 43436, 55979, 39046, 51-12 | Agent computes incorrect value but uses right type. | KNOWLEDGE | Role Framing / Precision |

## Changes made this iteration (one row per edit — aim for MULTIPLE classes, incl. a NEW tool when a cluster needs one)
| cluster | edit class | file / tool | what & why it generalizes | protects passing? |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| FORMULA_INSTEAD_OF_VALUE | CONTRACT | prompt.md | Explicitly forbids formulas; requires literal values computed in Python. | Yes - passing tasks already do this. |
| EXCEL_ERROR_STRING | KNOWLEDGE | prompt.md | Adds rule to handle errors in Python and avoid writing error strings. | Yes - passing tasks do not write error strings. |
| MISSING_VALUES | BEHAVIORAL | prompt.md | Adds an ordered execution workflow with a verification step (read-back). | Yes - passing tasks have full coverage. |
| WRONG_VALUE_RIGHT_TYPE | ROLE | prompt.md | Frames agent as expert analyst; emphasizes precision and verification. | Yes - passing tasks are precise. |

## Verify-the-fix (one line per change: the trace it targets → what the guard/computation/new-tool now does on those exact inputs)
- 37378: wrote formula not value → contract line "Never write Excel formulas"; passing 12864 already write literals.
- 37456: wrote #N/A error string → error handling rule "do not write the error string to the cell"; passing 45635 does not write errors.
- 227-40: missing cells in range → "Verify" step in workflow requires reading back cells; passing 142-12 already has full coverage.
- 267-18: wrong value computed → "Precision" principle and "Verify" step encourage double-checking logic; passing 31628 is precise.

## Process & features used
- Serial fallback because the task set is small and the failure clusters are clear from the feedback.
- No prior iterations to read (first iteration).

## Good things to PRESERVE (do not let a future iteration undo these)
- The absolute prohibition of formulas in the output cells.
- The requirement to compute all values in Python.
- The mandatory verification step (read-back).

## Deliberately skipped (cluster + why — already-passing / needs gold / infra noise)
- None.
